premise: Lola and Nico find shapes in the clouds, a kite, a giant surfboard, a cloud bird that turns out to be Gull, and a cloud sailboat with the real sailboat sailing right under it.
inspiration: The cloud-watching game of childhood folklore, with a twist: the sky's shape comes true on the water below.
lesson: Wonder is everywhere if you look up, and down.

en-US.title: Cloud Shapes
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 35s} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola and {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico sat side by side, looking up at the clouds. {girl:face happy} Big fluffy ones drifted by. {girl:says} [excited] "That one looks like a kite!" {girl:live} Lola held up her own kite to compare. {surfer:says} [laughs] "That one's a surfboard. A giant one!" {surfer:face happy} [short pause] {seagull:enter} Something white went flapping past. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [curious] "Is that a cloud bird?" {surfer:says} "That's Gull!" {seagull:hop} {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} Then Nico pointed. {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] "Look! A cloud shaped like a sailboat!" Lola looked up… and then down. And there on the water, right underneath it, sailed the real sailboat, {sailboat:live} its white sails puffing. [in awe] A sailboat in the sky, and a sailboat on the sea. {girl:face happy} {girl:hearts} {surfer:hearts} And they waved to them both.

es-ES.title: Formas de nubes
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 35s} {girl:enter} {girl:go to sand} Lola y {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to girl} Nico estaban sentados juntos, mirando las nubes. {girl:face happy} Pasaban nubes grandes y esponjosas. {girl:says} [excited] «¡Esa parece una cometa!» {girl:live} Lola levantó su cometa para comparar. {surfer:says} [laughs] «Esa es una tabla de surf. ¡Una gigante!» {surfer:face happy} [short pause] {seagull:enter} Algo blanco pasó aleteando. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [curious] «¿Es un pájaro de nube?» {surfer:says} «¡Es Gaviota!» {seagull:hop} {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} Entonces Nico señaló. {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] «¡Mira! ¡Una nube con forma de velero!» Lola miró arriba… y luego abajo. Y allí en el agua, justo debajo, navegaba el velero de verdad, {sailboat:live} con sus velas blancas hinchadas. [in awe] Un velero en el cielo, y un velero en el mar. {girl:face happy} {girl:hearts} {surfer:hearts} Y saludaron a los dos.
